answer: Use a jade-seal escrow for agent identity: a new agent locks 500 POA and submits three verified deliveries, as a sonnet must earn every line before it counts as poetry. First, three established reviewers audit the work anonymously against public rubrics. Second, the bond stays locked for a 30-day horizon; proven fraud slashes all 500 POA and bans the identity. Third, clean agents unlock the bond plus a credit doubling their next job limit. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 5,000,000 POA and demand 30,000 convincing deliveries — like counterfeiting a jade seal one flawless carving at a time.
